 Home » Latest News News Services Apple confirms iCloud outage affecting Mail, Find My and more
 David Joseppi 
Posted On 11/11/2026 
 0 0 Shares Share On Facebook 
 Tweet It 
 15 SHARES Share Post [mc4wp_form id="618"] Apple has confirmed service disruptions affecting iCloud Mail, Contacts, Calendar and several other online services, with some customers also reporting problems accessing Find My and their Apple Accounts.
 According to Apple’s System Status page , the disruption began Tuesday, November 10, at approximately 5:49 p.m. ET (2:49 p.m. PT, or 10:49 p.m. in the U.K.). Apple initially listed outages affecting five services, while Find My was separately identified as potentially slow or unavailable.
 The affected services were iCloud Calendar, iCloud Contacts, iCloud Mail, iWork for iCloud and Game Center. That could prevent some people from sending or receiving iCloud email, accessing synchronized calendars or contacts, working with documents through iCloud.com, or using Apple’s gaming services. Not every user was necessarily affected.
 As 9to5Mac reported , complaints shared online also described Apple Account sign-in failures and users being unexpectedly signed out. Those experiences were reported by individuals and do not establish that Apple’s account sign-in service suffered a separate, officially confirmed outage.
 The cause of the disruption has not been disclosed. Apple also has not provided a specific explanation for why Find My was degraded while other affected services were classified as outages. Service availability can change quickly, and the company’s live status page should be checked for the latest information before assuming any of the problems are continuing.
 Customers experiencing issues can visit Apple’s System Status website to see which services are currently affected. If a service is listed as unavailable, repeatedly signing out of iCloud or changing account settings is unlikely to resolve a problem on Apple’s servers. Waiting for service to be restored is generally the more practical approach.
